saw_lines: Most people buy tires only when the old set fails or winter arrives, then compare size, price and installation before clicking.
So the sale is lost on the size question, when a buyer cannot confirm the fit and leaves before price.
Your site shows over 3 500 reviews at 4,7 out of 5 and the next Google batch should lead with that rating on the creative ahead of the brand list.
ads_1: Google creative led by the review rating, with fit shots for each tire size
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
